_about: Parity lane A (the crew loop, 2026-10-10): the house's two board scripts krew did not carry yet, copied from the reference install (kanban-chatter.py, the per-event roll writer the atomic one replaced and still the house's own file; krew-board-roll-ready.py, the drained-board gate a board roll asks first) and the board roll's opt-in, timerless unit; the hold sweep's mode step (krew-mode-hold-sweep). imports.test_only: the ported board tests import the crew/lib modules they cover (each test puts crew/lib on sys.path), the lane-B precedent for janitor/.

crew-loop-parity.about: kanban-chatter.py (board events -> the Wall's log roll, one pass; the timer runs kanban-chatter-atomic.py), krew-board-roll-ready.py (exit 0 = the board may roll, 1 = it waits: every open card counts, parks included) and krew-board-roll.service (no timer, opt-in; ExecCondition asks the gate, the roll command is the install's own). krew-mode-hold-sweep is the hold sweep unit's second step, as on the reference install: krew-mode's `hold-sweep` through the one mode command (crew/lib/krew_mode_cmd.py: KREW_MODE_BIN, KREW_MODE_PATH, the install's link, else the krew-mode beside it); a failed sweep fails the unit (KREW_MODE_SWEEP_STRICT=0 reports it).
